title: 3M agrees to pay up to $7.35 billion in PFAS water contamination settlement involving 120,000 people
summary_full: In a landmark decision, 3M has agreed to a $7.35 billion resolution for personal injury claims linked to PFAS exposure. This crucial settlement is designed to aid individuals asserting health damages from polluted water and products. The claims process is set up to fairly assess and settle cases expeditiously, with around 120,000 potential beneficiaries meeting defined eligibility criteria. This agreement marks a pivotal move toward tackling PFAS-related health problems.
